sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Shukla,Anurag Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

By means of this application, the applicant, Parvesh @ Pravesh, who is involved in Case Crime No.
13 of 2021, under Sections 376-D, 366, 342, 323 I.P.C., Police Station Rajepur, District Farrukhabad and is in jail since 14.01.2021, is seeking enlargement on bail during the trial.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that similarly placed co-accused, Nanhe @
Pradeep, has already been enlarged on bail by this Court by order dated 12.4.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 43660 of 2021.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 43660 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He has further submitted that since the role of the applicant is identical to that of co-accused, Nanhe @ Pradeep, who has already been enlarged on bail, he is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity and for the reasons given in the order of co-accused.
Parvesh @ Pravesh vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023

entities.text: Parvesh @ Pravesh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The prayer for bail has vehemently been opposed by learned A.G.A.

Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A.,
this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for grant of bail on the ground of parity.

In view of the above, let the applicant be released on bail on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
1. The applicant will continue to attend and co-operate in the trial pending before the court concerned on the date fixed after release.
2. He will not tamper with the witnesses.
3. He will not indulge in any illegal activities during the bail period.
It is further directed that the identity, status and residence proof of the sureties be verified by the authorities concerned before he is accepted.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the trial court will be at liberty to cancel the bail.

Order Date :- 19.1.2023 Rohit  Parvesh @ Pravesh vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3372208/
